description: This source file defines the GatewayPayloadDecoding enum with static methods for decoding JSON payloads into Swift decodable types, utilizing the Foundation JSONEncoder and JSONDecoder.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a payload of type AnyCodable into a specified Decodable type T, by encoding the payload to JSON data and then decoding it.

methods.name: decodeIfPresent
methods.description: Decodes an optional payload of type AnyCodable into an optional Decodable type T, returning nil if payload is nil.
